brand_identity.name: Strade d'Italia
brand_identity.target_audience: Russian-speaking tourists planning road trips in Italy
brand_identity.design_archetype: Swiss Editorial meets Italian Dolce Vita

scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
scale.h2: text-3xl md:text-5xl font-serif font-normal tracking-tight leading-tight
scale.caption: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground/80

modes.editorial: Single column text (col-span-8 col-start-3) with breakout images (col-span-full)
modes.bento: Asymmetrical grid for galleries (mix of col-span-4, col-span-6, col-span-8)
modes.dashboard: Dense grid for data tables (tolls, distances) - use col-span-3 or col-span-4

buttons.primary: bg-[#1A4D2E] text-white hover:bg-[#143B23] rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-[1.02]
buttons.secondary: border border-[#1A4D2E] text-[#1A4D2E] bg-transparent hover:bg-[#1A4D2E]/5 rounded-full px-6 py-4 transition-all

cards.style: bg-white border border-[#D1CEC7] p-6 md:p-8 rounded-none shadow-none hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 group

navigation.style: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#F2F0E9]/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#D1CEC7]/50

visual_enhancers.textures: Add subtle grain overlay to the main background for 'paper' feel

pages_structure.home: Hero (Tuscany), Quick Links Grid (Tolls, Rules, Routes), Featured Scenic Drive
pages_structure.autostrade: Map visualization (static or interactive), Toll Calculator Component, Rules List
pages_structure.scenic: Masonry Gallery of routes, Itinerary Cards
pages_structure.services: Split layout: Gas Stations vs Rest Stops info

instructions_to_main_agent: Use the custom color palette defined above. Override Tailwind config immediately.
Install 'Playfair Display' and 'JetBrains Mono' via Google Fonts.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn cards. Build custom 'Swiss Style' cards with minimal borders and generous padding.
Ensure all text has high contrast (APCA compliant). The Green #1A4D2E is safe on White/Limestone.
Use the 'Bento' grid for the homepage navigation links.
Implement a 'Grain' texture overlay on the body background.
For the 'Toll Calculator', use a clean form layout with the Accent Gold #E6B325 for the 'Calculate' button.
universal_guidelines: Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
